testcase.name: Scenario: Hide and restore Team Web from Show Panels: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-panel-visibility-source/features/application/ribbon-panel-visibility/ribbon-panel-visibility.feature:718:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Hide and restore Team Web from Show Panels ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open and active ✔ And the full Tools ribbon is visible ✔ And the Team Web panel is visible ✔ When the user opens Show Panels from the Options panel title menu ✔ Then Team Web is checked ✔ When the user selects Team Web ✔ Then the Team Web panel disappears from the Tools ribbon ✔ And the other visible Tools panels remain available ✔ When the user reopens Show Panels from the Options panel title menu ✔ Then Team Web is unchecked ✔ When the user selects Team Web ✔ Then the Team Web panel appears on the Tools ribbon ✔ And Show Panels marks Team Web as visible
